request: In the watchlist, show movies I haven't watched yet before the ones I've watched.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when the checkbox is clicked
requests.reason: This test depended on the previous rendered order: after clicking the first row's checkbox it re-queried items()[0]'s checkbox via checkbox(), which only pointed at the same checkbox because a toggled movie used to stay in place. With the required unwatched-first ordering, the movie that becomes watched re-renders at the end of the list, so the index-based re-query now finds the other (still unchecked) checkbox and the assertion fails. The edit holds a reference to the clicked checkbox before the click, preserving the test's intent (clicking a checkbox toggles that movie); all other assertions are unchanged and the test still passes under the old ordering too.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when blank space on the row is clicked
requests.reason: Same conflict with the new ordering requirement: clicking blank space on the first row makes that movie watched, so the row moves to the bottom of the rendered list; the original assertion checkbox() re-queried whatever is now first, which would be the other movie's unchecked checkbox and fail. The edit keeps a reference to the clicked row and asserts on the checkbox inside it, preserving the test's intent that clicking blank space on a row toggles that row's movie.
